blocks.name: Callout
blocks.summary: Highlighted note for a decision, risk, warning, or outcome.
blocks.example:
<Callout tone="decision" title="Store MDX next to Markdown">
Plans keep YAML frontmatter; only the body syntax changes.
</Callout>

blocks.name: Columns
blocks.summary: Side-by-side container for structured comparisons such as Before / After.
blocks.example:
<Columns>
<Column label="Before">
Pandoc renders Markdown only.
</Column>
<Column label="After">
MDX plans render typed blocks.
</Column>
</Columns>

label.doc: Column heading, e.g. Before or After

blocks.name: Tabs
blocks.summary: Horizontal tabs; use under a "## Key changes" heading to group Diff blocks.

label.doc: Tab label, usually a file basename

blocks.name: FileTree
blocks.summary: Footprint of the change: files grouped by directory with change flags and stats.
blocks.example: <FileTree files={[{ path: "src/lib/mdx/render.tsx", change: "added", note: "MDX renderer", additions: 420 }, { path: "src/lib/storage.ts", change: "modified", additions: 12, deletions: 4 }]} />

blocks.name: Diff
blocks.summary: Literal before/after code with optional line annotations. Split mode by default.

before.doc: Old text; use a JSON string such as {"line 1\nline 2"}

summary.doc: One-line description shown under the title

annotations.doc: [{ line, note, side?: "before" | "after" }] — line numbers default to the after side

blocks.example: <Diff filename="src/lib/storage.ts" summary="List .mdx plans alongside .md" before={"if (!name.endsWith('.md')) continue"} after={"if (!isPlanFilename(name)) continue"} annotations={[{ line: 1, note: "Accepts .md and .mdx" }]} />

blocks.name: AnnotatedCode
blocks.summary: A new file or added block, with notes pinned to the lines that matter.

code.doc: Source text as a JSON string

summary.doc: One-line description shown under the title

blocks.example: <AnnotatedCode filename="src/lib/mdx/format.ts" code={"export function isMdx(meta) {\n  return meta.format === 'mdx'\n}"} annotations={[{ line: 2, note: "Frontmatter is the portable signal" }]} />

blocks.name: DataModel
blocks.summary: Entities, fields, and relations, with per-field change flags and prior types.

entities.doc: [{ name, change?, note?, fields: [{ name, type, key?: "pk" | "fk", change?, was?, note? }] }]

blocks.example: <DataModel entities={[{ name: "PlanMetadata", fields: [{ name: "id", type: "string", key: "pk" }, { name: "format", type: "\"md\" | \"mdx\"", change: "added" }] }]} />

blocks.name: Endpoint
blocks.summary: HTTP contract after the change. Children are the prose description.

change.doc: Diff-aware flag rendered as a badge

deprecated.doc: Marks a removed or retired route

params.doc: [{ name, in: "path" | "query" | "header" | "body", type, required?, change?, was?, note? }]

request.doc: { contentType?, example? } — example is a single JSON value as a string

blocks.example:
<Endpoint method="GET" path="/api/plans/:id" responses={[{ status: 200, example: "{\"format\":\"mdx\"}" }]}>
Returns rendered HTML for Markdown and MDX plans.
</Endpoint>

blocks.name: Flow
blocks.summary: Ordered steps with arrows, for genuinely sequential mechanics.
blocks.example: <Flow steps={[{ label: "plan.mdx", detail: "frontmatter + MDX" }, { label: "remark-mdx", detail: "parse, never eval" }, { label: "React", detail: "whitelisted blocks" }]} />

blocks.name: Layers
blocks.summary: Stacked groups (layers, regions, ownership boundaries) for architecture.

layers.doc: [{ label, note?, items: [string | { label, change?, note? }] }]

blocks.example: <Layers layers={[{ label: "Surfaces", items: ["Local dashboard", "Hosted app"] }, { label: "Renderer", items: [{ label: "src/lib/mdx", change: "added" }] }]} />

blocks.name: Questions
blocks.summary: The single bottom block of open questions, each with a recommended default.
blocks.example: <Questions items={[{ question: "Render Mermaid?", recommendation: "Defer; needs client JS", options: ["Defer", "Bundle mermaid"] }]} />
